# Data at 0x402040

    0x60, 0x20, 0xf9, 0xbe, 0x3b, 0xd3, 0x42, 0xf6,
    0x94, 0x37, 0xb5, 0x66, 0xf4, 0x65, 0x11, 0xad,
    0x24, 0xd5, 0x7c, 0x21, 0xeb, 0x2b, 0x7b, 0x4b, 0xd6
])

# The XOR validation loop:
# edx starts at 0x26
# For each byte at position rax in input:

#   esi = edx XOR ecx
#   Compare sil with expected[rax]

    ecx = ord(input_str[i])
    esi = edx ^ ecx
    expected = expected_bytes[i]
    match = (esi & 0xFF) == expected

print("\nAll matched!" if i == 24 else "Failed!")
